notes.title: new speed(run&gun)level, new enemy and some (bug)fixes
notes.content:
chicory-rockets 25% smaller
speed-boosts higher and reached earlier for all difficulties
farmlandspeedrun-level-2 - now has random-height sideways ladyfinger-rockets instead of fly's
fixed where in speed(run&gun)'s at very-high speeds one would become airborne and lesser able to jump
some minor bug-fixes

further we welcome the leek to the farmlands-family



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42797899/7c61131affedcdeedbb4dcede909230e1908c994.png
leek(can be pushed, toppled over and jumped from)

notes.title: new (speed)run&gun-level, new enemy and some (bug)fixes
notes.content:
ladyfinger-rockets now have distance-correlated-sound-volume
fixed a bug where strawberry-animation started with the raspberry-sprite
fixed a bug where one would still end up pushed through the ground in some cases
some other minor bug-fixes

further we welcome the beet to the farmlands-family

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42797899/f665d108d3af08926979a601218a9ac1b26680ad.png
(jumps out of the ground and if not jumped-on from above, becomes a rotating hindrance)

notes.title: new level, new enemy and some (bug-)fixes
notes.content:
the fly can be shot better
oranges stick lesser to each other
jumping on a orange on low-angles doesn't decrease speed
fixed a bug in which sometimes if at slow speed and pushed-down directly from above one could be pushed through the ground



further we welcome the chayote to the farmlands-family

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42797899/72e2cefe4a47b8bf35f7ea6be4eb1e8fa9eea2ab.png
chayote(falls down from a plant when near to then obstruct the way)

notes.title: new level, new enemies and some (bug-)fixes
notes.content:
to access the new-level one must complete the rose-boss(level5) first, then the thorns will move

dandelion-seeds can now be shot better
fixed a bug where a raspberry could explode twice upon hitting the ground
fixed where on distance the raspberries animation caused a significant decrease in the frame-rate when on low-hardware-specifications 
level 5 made easyer + butterfly-crash-bug-fixed
(fixed a bug where the save at the boss of grassflowerlandslevel4 would be loaded also in grassflowerlandslevel5)

notes.title: new level/enemies/map-expansion+update and some bug-fixes
notes.content:
new level/enemies/map-expansion+update and some bug-fixes

-expanded the map-level - and when one has defeated the boss -> shows with various colored-circles over the level-icon
-improved the cucumber-super-jump + lives - and no more damage when cucumbers rise and one stand on them
-fixed a bug where aspargus/horseradish sometimes didnt (immediatly) come out of the ground
- added extra lives in the farmlandslevels
